Hannah (marketing): Quick ping  our weekly KPI board shows the launch-post series drove +42% visits but MQLs are flat. Need a quick triage before Friday's execs. Link: https://dash.redwood/boards/launch_ripple :mag_right:
Caleb (growth): which step is diverging? click->reg or reg->mql?
Hannah (marketing): clicks -> regs up, regs -> MQL flat. So registration quality looks lower.
Priya (analytics): running a cohort split now. Early signal: LinkedIn traffic has higher regs but lower enrichment scores (fewer profiles completed). Email traffic shows higher MQL share.
Omar (ops): dashbot reported a transient enrichment worker restart at 05:42 UTC yesterday. dashbot: enrichment-worker restart, processed backlog by 06:05 UTC.
deckbot: reminder Weekly KPI slides due Friday 09:00 PT.
Caleb (growth): could be two things: traffic quality shift (LinkedIn copy/targeting) or enrichment timing losing some fields. Which is it?
Priya (analytics): I sampled 100 regs from the high-LinkedIn window: 34 had incomplete company fields and 9 had suspiciously fast completion times (possible bots). I can run bot-score and crm-merge diffs.
Hannah (marketing): we did change the LinkedIn creative on Tue — leaned into shorter copy with a soft CTA. Might attract broader traffic.
Caleb (growth): ok lets do parallel checks: 1) Priya re-run attribution + bot-filtering on that window, 2) Omar check enrichment backfill and worker logs, 3) Hannah hold on headline language for execs until we have clarity.
Omar (ops): opening INC-2025-0842 for the enrichment restart and backfill verification. I'll confirm whether any fields were lost or rehydrated on backfill.
Priya (analytics): kicking job `reproc_20250402_0610` with bot_score and crm_merge stats. ETA ~8m. Will post small CSV and summary.
Hannah (marketing): thanks. also can someone run per-channel MQL rate under time-decay vs last-touch? I want to see if LinkedIn contribution is understated by last-touch.
Priya (analytics): quick numbers: last-touch LinkedIn MQLs = 118, time-decay(14d) LinkedIn MQLs = 162 (+37%). So time-decay shows more impact; but if many of those are low-quality regs, we should be careful.
Caleb (growth): agree. For the deck, propose: headline uses conservative last-touch overall, call out that time-decay shows higher reach for LinkedIn in appendix, and include a short note about traffic quality differences and infra restart annotation.
Priya (analytics): reproc done : results show recovered MQLs in that window +29 (post-reproc 141 vs pre 112). bot_filtered_reinstated=6, crm_merges=4. CSV: https://jobs.internal/reproc_20250402_0610/export.csv
Omar (ops): confirmed backfill rehydrated fields; no data loss persisted. Added dashboard annotation for 2025-04-02 05:40-06:10 UTC and increased enrichment-worker alert thresholds.
Hannah (marketing): OK great. I'll draft KPI slide: headline = "Launch posts drove 1,240 visits; 1,024 MQLs (last-touch)." Appendix: time-decay sensitivity shows LinkedIn lifts +37% and recovered counts after reprocess. Note: enrichment restart annotated.
Caleb (growth): remind deck to include routing note: we saw a slight shift in inbound routing to SDRs B this week which may affect SLA->qualified timing. Add a brief line in appendix so CS doesn't get surprised.
Hannah (marketing): will add. thanks team  will send deck to execs after I attach appendix and the reproc CSV. :rocket:
